purpose: Photographed sizes of the species people want from each locality, for the story-pocket size targets (proposals/PROPOSAL-STORY-POCKETS-2026-10-21.md, revised 2026-10-22). The raw caption text around every length a photograph caption states, by photograph; tools/story-pocket-size-evidence.mjs classes each length (crystal, aggregate, specimen, picture width) and summarises them.
source: Mineralienatlas (www.mineralienatlas.de), the locality photograph pages the locality review already counts (proposals/DATA-LOCALITY-ABUNDANCE-2026-10-21.json, mineralienatlas.location_ids). Read in an ordinary browser session, page by page, by navigating to each page and reading the loaded document; nothing was fetched by script.

extractor.note: Each page payload carries fn = SHA-256 of the extractor function's source text and sha256 = SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(payload without sha256), both computed in the page at capture. tools/story-pocket-size-evidence.mjs recomputes both and refuses any mismatch.

sampling: Per locality, the wanted species are the record's (compare.json rows with at least 5 % of the record, not set aside, plus the named collectibles where the record is thin), under every Mineralienatlas name that maps to them (localities.<loc>.names).

The overview page (LokationMineralBilder, recurse=1, all sub-localities) shows up to 6 photographs per mineral section; it was read first. Then the galleries (MediaDataShow, 60 photographs a page) of the wanted sections, largest section first, until at least 20 photographs of the species had been read or every section had been read. A gallery's later pages were read only where its first page fell short (labels "p1" … ).

A row is a photograph whose first-listed mineral is a wanted name and whose caption states a length (mm, cm or µm): [image id, first-listed mineral, number of minerals listed, the caption text from 30 characters before each length to 15 after, overlapping stretches merged]. leadCounts[name] = [photographs of that first-listed mineral on the page, of them with a stated length]; a photograph shown on both an overview and a gallery page counts on both.
Not captured: Sulphur Bank (no photograph of a wanted species); Cumbria, Skardu and Haramosh (no location id in the data file); the Elmwood 1420 overview (its galleries cover every section).
sections_note: sections[overview location id] = [mineral name, photographs in the section, shown on the overview, "location id/mineral id" of its gallery] for every section of every overview read: the coverage accounting. Not hashed (it was read from the same pages, after capture).
